children: Shares of upscale home furnishing retailer Arhaus

were launched higher on Monday, opening above its 50-, 100-, and 200-day moving averages thanks to "newfound optimism" from Jefferies’ Jonathan Matuszewski stemming from the company’s efforts to increase its exposure to consumers.

broadened its catalog circulation and increased its digital marketing efforts, translating into a 104% year-over-year increase in website traffic over the past four weeks and continuing into the first half of September with a 107% year-over-year increase.

Matuszewski believes this increased opportunity translates into a comparable sales tailwind of 150 to 200 basis points and potential for a 75 to 200 basis point comparable sales lift in 2027 from the expanded catalogue mailing.
To facilitate the digital marketing initiative, Arhaus is expected to name a new chief marketing officer and chief digital officer over the next few months.
